```{r}
#| label: inject-dvf-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (dvf_ready) {
  # Sérialisation : tableau plat, indexé en JS pour minimiser la taille
  dvf_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(dvf_nested, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
  dvf_breaks_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(dvf_breaks, auto_unbox = FALSE)
  dvf_palette_js  <- jsonlite::toJSON(.dvf_palette)
  dvf_na_color_js <- jsonlite::toJSON(.dvf_na_color)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.dvfRaw = ', as.character(dvf_json), ';\n',
      'window.dvfBreaks = ', as.character(dvf_breaks_json), ';\n',
      'window.dvfPalette = ', as.character(dvf_palette_js), ';\n',
      'window.dvfNAColor = ', as.character(dvf_na_color_js), ';\n',
      '// Indexer : window.dvfData[code][type][annee] = {pm, n}\n',
      'window.dvfData = {};\n',
      'window.dvfRaw.forEach(function(r) {\n',
      '  if (!window.dvfData[r.code]) window.dvfData[r.code] = {};\n',
      '  if (!window.dvfData[r.code][r.type]) window.dvfData[r.code][r.type] = {};\n',
      '  window.dvfData[r.code][r.type][r.annee] = { pm: r.pm, n: r.n };\n',
      '});\n',
      '// Color picker selon le type et le prix\n',
      'window.dvfColorFor = function(prix, type) {\n',
      '  if (prix == null || prix === undefined) return window.dvfNAColor;\n',
      '  var breaks = window.dvfBreaks[type];\n',
      '  for (var i = 1; i < 5; i++) { if (prix < breaks[i]) return window.dvfPalette[i-1]; }\n',
      '  return window.dvfPalette[4];\n',
      '};\n',
      '// Re-couleur tous les polygones de la carte DVF\n',
      'window.dvfRecolor = function(year, type) {\n',
      '  var map = window.dvfMap;\n',
      '  if (!map) return;\n',
      '  map.eachLayer(function(layer) {\n',
      '    if (!layer.options || !layer.options.layerId) return;\n',
      '    var code = layer.options.layerId;\n',
      '    var ent = window.dvfData[code] && window.dvfData[code][type] && window.dvfData[code][type][year];\n',
      '    var color = window.dvfColorFor(ent && ent.pm, type);\n',
      '    layer.setStyle({ fillColor: color, fillOpacity: (ent ? 0.85 : 0.30) });\n',
      '  });\n',
      '  // Mettre à jour la légende\n',
      '  var legendTitle = document.querySelector(".dvf-legend .lgd-title");\n',
      '  if (legendTitle) legendTitle.textContent = "Prix m² · " + type + " · " + year;\n',
      '};\n',
      '// Panneau DVF\n',
      'window.updateDvfPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("dvf-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var entries = window.dvfData[code];\n',
      '  var elecInfo = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt      = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elecInfo ? elecInfo.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elecInfo ? (elecInfo.libelle_dept + " (" + elecInfo.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!entries) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de transaction publiée (mono-local, App/Maison) sur 2021-2024.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  var years = [2021,2022,2023,2024];\n',
      '  function trendBar(type) {\n',
      '    var ent = entries[type];\n',
      '    if (!ent) return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend-empty\\">Pas de " + type.toLowerCase() + "</div>";\n',
      '    var vals = years.map(function(y){return ent[y] ? ent[y].pm : null;});\n',
      '    var maxV = Math.max.apply(null, vals.filter(function(v){return v!=null;}));\n',
      '    if (maxV <= 0 || !isFinite(maxV)) return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend-empty\\">Pas de " + type.toLowerCase() + "</div>";\n',
      '    var bars = years.map(function(y,i){\n',
      '      var v = vals[i];\n',
      '      var h = v ? Math.round(v / maxV * 100) : 0;\n',
      '      var lbl = v ? Math.round(v).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—";\n',
      '      var nb = (ent[y] && ent[y].n) || 0;\n',
      '      return "<div class=\\"dvf-bar-col\\"><div class=\\"dvf-bar-vert\\"><div class=\\"dvf-bar-fillv\\" style=\\"height:" + h + "%;\\" title=\\"" + lbl + " €/m² · " + nb + " ventes\\"></div></div><div class=\\"dvf-bar-y\\">" + y + "</div><div class=\\"dvf-bar-val\\">" + lbl + "</div></div>";\n',
      '    }).join("");\n',
      '    return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend\\"><div class=\\"dvf-trend-label\\">" + type + "</div><div class=\\"dvf-bars\\">" + bars + "</div></div>";\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Prix m² médian (€) par année</h4>\' +\n',
      '    trendBar("Appartement") + trendBar("Maison") + \'</div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-dvf
if (dvf_ready) {
  m <- choropleth_dvf(com_metro_only, dep_metro, dvf_default_year, dvf_breaks$Appartement)
  m |>
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x) {
         window.dvfMap = this;
         var self = this;
         function attach() {
           self.eachLayer(function(layer) {
             if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId && !layer._dvfClickOn) {
               layer._dvfClickOn = true;
               layer.on('click', function(e) {
                 var code = e.target.options.layerId;
                 if (window.updateDvfPanel) window.updateDvfPanel(code);
               });
             }
           });
         }
         self._cpReattach = attach;
         setTimeout(attach, 60);
         setTimeout(attach, 500);
         setTimeout(attach, 2000);
         self.on('layeradd', function() { setTimeout(attach, 0); });
         // Bind radios → recolor
         function readSel() {
           var y = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-year]:checked');
           var t = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-type]:checked');
           return { year: y ? +y.value : 2024, type: t ? t.value : 'Appartement' };
         }
         function updateBreaks() {
           // Met à jour les seuils dans la légende selon le type courant
           var sel = readSel();
           var breaks = window.dvfBreaks[sel.type];
           var labels = document.querySelectorAll('.dvf-legend .lgd-row .lgd-label');
           for (var i = 0; i < 5 && i < labels.length; i++) {
             var lo = Math.round(breaks[i]).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
             var hi = Math.round(breaks[i+1]).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
             labels[i].textContent = lo + ' – ' + hi + ' €/m²';
           }
         }
         function onChange() {
           var sel = readSel();
           if (window.dvfRecolor) window.dvfRecolor(sel.year, sel.type);
           updateBreaks();
         }
         setTimeout(function() {
           document.querySelectorAll('input[name=dvf-year], input[name=dvf-type]')
             .forEach(function(r) { r.addEventListener('change', onChange); });
         }, 300);
       }"
    )
} else {
  htmltools::HTML(
    "<p style='padding:2rem;color:#7A7A7A;'>",
    "DVF non chargé. Lancer<br><code>Rscript scripts/03_dvf_aggregate.R</code>",
    "</p>"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: drom-dvf-prep
#| include: false
if (dvf_ready) {
  dvf_drom_vals <- dvf |>
    dplyr::filter(annee == YEAR_DEFAULT, type_local == TYPE_DEFAULT,
                  !estimation_insuffisante) |>
    dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = prix_m2_median)
  .dvf_drom_palette <- c("#F5F2EC", "#D9C896", "#C0A05A", "#92722A", "#5E4615")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: drom-imm-971

                              palette = .dvf_drom_palette,
                              scale   = "log_quantile")
} else if (data_ready) drom_inset(dep_drom, "971")
```
